title: Roaming in America
subtitle: A journey through the structure of time and history.

trails.title: Ancient Calendar
trails.description: Will we see the sixth sun?

content.text: The Story of the Sun Stone

The Aztec Sun Stone is often called the "Aztec Calendar." But it's really more of a cosmic map carved in basalt—or, as the Aztecs understood it, a guide to how the world works.

The stone was unearthed in Mexico City in the 18th century. It measures over 3.5 meters across and weighs more than 20 tons. The center of the Sun Stone is Tōnatiuh, the god of the sun. His gaze is stern, his outstretched tongue carved to resemble a Tecpatl. The message is clear: offer the sun your most precious gift—your blood—or receive nothing in return.

The concentric rings around Tōnatiuh record the four "suns" that came before—one transformed into a jaguar and devoured the people, one engulfed the world in a hurricane, one rained fire from the heavens, and the last drowned the world in a massive flood. Each sun's reign ended in an apocalypse, and none of their subjects survived.

Moving outward, you'll find religious symbols, patterns marking the cycle of day and night, and colors representing celestial bodies ... They unfold layer by layer, like a cosmic machine disassembled and laid bare—precise, ancient, orderly. Together, they capture the Aztec understanding of the world: the universe resets, all things are reborn, and humanity is nothing more than a speck of dust within it.

items.text: The night of the art auction.
It's already a quarter past twelve—fifteen minutes past their agreed meeting time. Yet the mysterious bandit is a no-show. Añil grows more anxious with every passing minute.
A click comes from the side door.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: I thought ... Never mind.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Ms. Butterfly, you're late.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Sorry, my "luck" always seems to lead me into trouble.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Once, I was tracking down a woman in Barcelona—an arcanist who was dragged into some Critter lover's parade, I almost broke a leg.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: And then in Casablanca, I was a split second from shooting my target dead. But the moment I pulled the trigger, he turned to stone. Turns out his old rival cast a petrifying incantation on him.
Her apology is a half-hearted politeness. She pays him little mind as she stows away the badge she used to pick the lock.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: You have quite the intriguing past.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Has the auction started?

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Yes. The guests have all arrived.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Excellent. When the lights are all fixed on the stage, it'll be the perfect time to sneak in.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Though, I don't hear a sound. You sure you didn't take me to a funeral by accident?

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: This isn't the auction venue.
The forger leads her toward the giant Sun Stone exhibit.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: After the Spanish conquered Tenochtitlán, the new archbishop buried the Sun Stone, a symbol of Aztec civilization, to erase their "pagan heresy."

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: The stone was rediscovered in 1790 during repairs to the Mexico City Cathedral.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Thus it's said that the Cathedral was built on the Templo Mayor of the Aztec civilization.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Don't tell me this massive rock above me is the only genuine artifact in the building.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: What will you say next? That you stole it from the museum?

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: Haha, of course not.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: It's merely another forgery to decorate the club. When foreign buyers feel immersed in an "exotic ancient civilization," they start to loosen their purse strings.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: I joined its production, not certain I was entirely successful in recreating its complex color.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: This Sun Stone is the entrance to the auction.

items.speaker: Añil
items.text: If you will, miss, I believe you know how to activate it.
